STEP 6. Check the harness wires between rear wiper 
motor connector F-07 and ETACS-ECU connector C-114.
NOTE: After checking intermediate connectors F-24 and 
junction block connector C-113, check the wires. If intermediate 
connectors F-24 and junction block connector C-113 are 
damaged, repair or replace them. Refer to GROUP 00E, 
Harness Connector Inspection P.00E-2.
Q: Are the harness wires between rear wiper motor 
connector F-07 and ETACS-ECU connector C-114 in 
good condition?
YES : Replace the ETACS-ECU. The rear wiper should 
work normally.
NO : Repair them. The rear wiper should work normally.
